name: Dipole
author: Abstract Games factory
description: Dipole (Mark Steere, 2007): a checkers-set stacking duel on the 32 dark squares. Each player starts with a single 12-high pole. Split any number of checkers off the top of a stack and move them exactly that many squares -- forward or diagonally forward to move or merge, in any of the eight directions to capture a whole enemy stack no taller than the movers. Nothing blocks a move, and a stack driven off the edge is removed from play. Win by clearing every enemy checker from the board; run yourself off the edge and you lose. Draws cannot occur.
